violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(B))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets
violation_type.typical_finding: Infant play yards were observed to have loose fitting sheets.

finding_variants.text: Infant play yards were observed to have loose fitting sheets.
A play yard used by an infant was observed without a snug fitting sheet on the mattress.
A play yard being used by an infant did not have a fitted sheet on the mattress.
The sheets in one of the infant rooms did not fit properly.

One play yard in the infant classroom had a loose mattress sheet.    Fitted sheet in one play yard's mattress was loose. The fitted sheet was oversized.      Note: Sheet was removed during inspection.
It was observed that the cover sheet was not snug fitting on two of the pack and play.  Pictures taken during inspection.
